source: Direct user instruction in the concentric-border side conversation
instruction: Show where the underlying tile over-cut, especially the gouges at the top of the tile, lands underneath the exposed custom escutcheon border. Make the adjustment before reporting the work to thread 01a13c51-58ac-7a90-95ed-957781ad5347.
required_view: Front-facing overlay of existing scan-derived opening and damage traces on the unchanged primary scan render, with both the factory-cover perimeter and the concentric custom-plate perimeter visible. Include a top-gouge close-up and a transparent/reveal control.
required_dimensions: Distance the limiting gouge extends radially beyond the factory-cover edge
Remaining projected distance from the gouge trace to the custom-plate outer edge
The same remaining distance after the documented tracing allowance
evidence_rules: Use existing registered primary-scan coordinates and the original render bytes; do not paint invented defects into the image or shift traces to improve coverage.
Keep CUT-02 and CUT-07 identified as uncertain marks; do not reclassify them as confirmed gouges.
The overlay reveals retained evidence for inspection; it does not mean damage remains visible after the actual opaque plate is fitted.
Projected margins are not verified sound-stone support, a sealing width, a damage-depth measurement or a fabrication release.
